argv: $cfg='E:\WebAIBridge\app\data\supervisor-watchdog.json'; $ms='E:\WebAIBridge\app\data\managed-chat-status.json'; if(Test-Path $cfg){$c=Get-Content $cfg -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Output ('ROOT|profileId='+$c.profileId+'|debugPort='+$c.debugPort+'|enabled='+$c.enabled+'|autoContinue='+$c.autoContinueEnabled+'|allowAutonomousSend='+$c.allowAutonomousSend); foreach($p in @($c.managedProjects)){Write-Output ('PROJECT|'+$p.id+'|'+$p.name+'|repo='+$p.repository+'|branch='+$p.branch+'|agents='+(@($p.agents|ForEach-Object{$_.id})-join ','))}}; if(Test-Path $ms){$m=Get-Content $ms -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json; foreach($x in @($m)){Write-Output ('STATUS|'+$x.id+'|'+$x.name+'|generating='+$x.generating+'|high='+$x.highMode+'|draft='+$x.hasDraft+'|profile='+$x.profileId+'|url='+$x.url)}} else {Write-Output 'NO_STATUS'}
